old_problem: Initial failed/buddy map, chip-select0x4 decode, reverse-bank/second-buddy allocation oracle, threshold decoder and recovery require platform authority.
disposition_reason: ED-16 requires approved injection and Recovery. Coordinates alone cannot establish those policy choices.

test_case.test_name: ADDDC buddy-rank in-region reverse and two-bank reallocation
test_case.purpose: Prove a threshold on the current buddy inside the protected bank triggers the approved reverse relationship and second bank allocation.
required_package: Attested failed/buddy region and CS0x4 decode
BIOS reverse buddy0x6 and second-allocation oracle
Dedicated SUT, SMM/OOB recovery and rollback
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator freezes the predecessor map, validates CS0x4/bank1 decode, applies exact mask and two CEs at the buddy, confirms threshold, executes go once, compares region/control to prove first bank rebuddied to0x6 and approved second failed/buddy allocation, then restores settings and verifies health.
test_case.expected_result: The in-region buddy threshold produces the exact reverse first-region relationship and BIOS-approved second bank VLS, with cleared bookkeeping and healthy final state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact buddy decode, two CEs, threshold, first buddy0x6, correct second allocation, cleared counter and restoration. Wrong decode/allocation, unchanged policy, extra mutation or instability fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Critical injection approval on isolated SUT.
Do not inject without predecessor and CS decode proof.
Exactly two CEs; stop on wrong first event.
No retry, extra allocation, reboot or inferred BIOS policy.
expected_evidence: CS0x4/bank1 decode and two CE transcripts
Before/after first reverse plus second-region table
test_case.recovery: On wrong rebuddy/allocation or hang, preserve region state and use approved OOB recovery without more injection; restore ADDDC/threshold settings and verify memory/spare topology.
